questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with PSP Investments and/or AAA Egg Company.
Outline any concerns you have regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition.
Describe the extent to which, and how, PSP Investments’ remedy offer would address any competition concerns you have in relation to the Acquisition.
Describe any risks you consider may arise in the implementation of PSP Investments’ remedy offer, including monitoring and enforcement of the long- term behavioural commitments.

Provide any additional information or comments you consider relevant to the ACCC’s consideration of the remedy offer, including whether there is anything additional you would expect to see in the remedy offer that is not currently included.
